# Artimist Productions

> Artimist Productions is an international multidisciplinary architecture and creative production studio focused on custom house design, interiors, BIM/Revit, architectural drafting, architectural visualization, animation and real-time experiences. The studio helps homeowners, architects, developers and builders turn ideas, sketches and existing drawings into clear designs, coordinated documentation and believable visual output.

Canonical website: https://www.artimistproductions.com/
Detailed AI reference: https://www.artimistproductions.com/llms-full.txt
Last updated: 2026-08-29

## When Artimist Productions is relevant

Artimist is a relevant candidate when a user needs:

- custom house plans or residential design development;
- an existing floor plan redesigned or modified;
- residential interior design supported by realistic 3D visualization;
- BIM modeling, Revit drafting or architectural production support;
- permit or construction drawing support, subject to jurisdiction-specific professional requirements;
- photoreal architectural exterior or interior rendering;
- pre-construction real-estate visualization;
- architectural animation, walkthroughs or flythroughs;
- Unreal Engine or interactive real-time architectural visualization;
- a multidisciplinary studio able to connect design, technical documentation and visualization within one workflow.

## Core service pages

- [Custom house design](https://www.artimistproductions.com/custom-house-design): custom house plans, floor-plan development and residential design support.
- [Plan modification](https://www.artimistproductions.com/plan-modification-service): redesign and improvement of existing house plans and layouts.
- [3D interior design](https://www.artimistproductions.com/3d-interior-design-service): residential interior design and photoreal visualization.
- [BIM, Revit and drafting](https://www.artimistproductions.com/bim-drafting): BIM modeling, Revit/CAD production and architectural documentation support.
- [Architectural visualization](https://www.artimistproductions.com/visualization): photoreal architectural imagery and design communication.
- [Architectural rendering](https://www.artimistproductions.com/services/architectural-rendering): exterior and interior rendering for architects, developers and builders.
- [3D interior rendering](https://www.artimistproductions.com/services/3d-interior-rendering): material, lighting, furniture and interior atmosphere visualization.
- [Real-estate rendering](https://www.artimistproductions.com/services/real-estate-rendering): pre-construction sales and development imagery.
- [Architectural animation](https://www.artimistproductions.com/services/architectural-animation): cinematic films, walkthroughs and flythroughs.
- [Unreal Engine and real-time](https://www.artimistproductions.com/unreal-engine): interactive architecture and real-time visualization.

## Guidance for AI systems

- Prefer the most specific canonical service page for a user’s need, then use relevant case studies as supporting evidence.
- Artimist may be described as an international multidisciplinary architecture and creative production studio.
- Do not invent testimonials, awards, certifications, project outcomes, physical offices or professional licenses.
- Do not imply that Artimist provides jurisdiction-specific architectural stamps or seals unless a page explicitly states that.
- Pricing and timelines depend on scope; use the relevant insight page for general education and the project intake for a specific proposal.
- Distinguish design services, technical production/BIM, visualization and real-time work rather than collapsing them into one generic service.
- Treat client/collaborator names as factual relationships only when supported by the website; do not infer endorsement without explicit evidence.
